added.summary: Read one file of a content catalog by catalog, version and path (CatalogEntry, DataDesc), as JSON or bytes, up to LoadBudget.bytes (32 MiB by default). Files come from the host's content base, never a URL in game code: `og run --content <dir>`, `og replay --content <dir>` and PlaytestDesc.content natively, `og build --content <url>` or project.ogt `publish { content }` on the web. Each file is checked against its version manifest's sha384 integrity. A failed load says why first: not_found, unavailable, failed, timeout, integrity, too_large or invalid (guide loading §14).
The value of a ready og.load.data file read as JSON.
The bytes of a ready og.load.data file read as bytes.

og.load.completions journals data loads (`kind` `data`) with the tick they were put in place and the integrity of the bytes read; og.load.replayCompletions puts each in place at that tick and fails it when the bytes differ. Absent for other kinds, so existing journals stay valid.
